notes.title: Color Dash is Here! 🌟
notes.notes:
The wait is over—Color Dash is officially live! 🎉 Dive into a world of vibrant action, where every step you take leaves a colorful trail and every move counts.

🎨 What to Expect:

Challenging Levels: Test your skills across a variety of traps and puzzles.
Creative Gameplay: Conserve your paint, strategize your path, and overcome obstacles with precision.
Unique Mechanics: Every step leaves a mark—your choices shape your journey.
We’re beyond thrilled to finally share Color Dash with you. This game has been a labor of love for our team, and we can’t wait to hear what you think. Your feedback is invaluable and will help us shape future updates.

📌 Don’t forget to add Color Dash to your wishlist if you haven’t already, and let us know your thoughts in the comments or on our social channels.

Thank you for your support, and happy dashing! 🚀

notes.title: Join Color Dash at Steam Next Fest!
notes.notes:
We're excited to announce that Color Dash is participating in Steam Next Fest! 🎉

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3260590/Color_Dash_Demo/

This is your chance to dive into the vibrant world of Color Dash, experience our demo, and test your skills across 34 challenging levels. We’d love to hear your thoughts and feedback, which will help us make the full game even better!

Your feedback means the world to us, and we can't wait to see how you enjoy the game! Try the demo, let us know what you think, and together, we’ll shape the future of Color Dash! 🎨✨

Thank you for your support!

notes.title: Color Dash Prepares for Steam Next Fest!
notes.notes:
Hello friends! Color Dash is here again! 🎨

We are excited to announce that we are preparing for Steam Next Fest and are thrilled to share some updates about our project. Our team is currently working hard on the demo version, so you can get a taste of the Color Dash world and experience everything that makes our game special. We hope you love it!

[previewyoutube=ohXgaH8NMMw;full][/previewyoutube]

For those who are already interested and can't wait, we have prepared a video showcasing the completion of several levels, along with a demonstration of the level editor. This editor will allow every player to create their own unique levels and share them with the community. We want you to not only play but also create and add your own touch to the Color Dash world. 🎥

Thank you for being with us! See you at Steam Next Fest and in the world of Color Dash! ✨

notes.title: Hello everyone! We’re happy to see you! 🎉
notes.notes:
Hi, friends! Color Dash is here with you! 🎨

We’re incredibly excited to see all of you who have already shown interest in our game at such an early stage! Color Dash started as a small passion project, and over time, we realized what a special game we wanted to create. We really hope that you’ll enjoy it as much as we do, because right now, our small team is working hard on a demo version to share it with you as soon as possible! ːsteamhappyː

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45218424/23e011bea122d286190ac18c2e8ba38ec16b290a.gif[/img]

We really want to engage with our community, share updates, and most importantly, hear your thoughts and suggestions. Your feedback truly matters to us! We've already prepared a [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2975330/discussions/0/4852155593256868889/]Frequently Asked Questions[/url] section where we tried to anticipate some of your questions. But if we missed something or you just want to say "hello" — feel free to write [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2975330/discussions/]in the discussions[/url], we’d love to chat! 😊

If you like Color Dash, please add our game to your wishlist if you haven’t already. For us, it’s not just a checkbox — it’s a form of support that helps us move forward and makes the game more visible to other players. 💖

Thank you for your attention and support! See you in the vibrant world of Color Dash! ✨
